name: CVInfotech Importer for Shopify and WooCommerce
author: CV Infotech

sections.description:
CVInfotech Importer for Shopify and WooCommerce is a professional, easy-to-use tool that helps you migrate products from any Shopify store to WooCommerce. Version 3.0.0 is completely rebuilt for reliability, simplicity, and proper variable product handling.

Key Features

  • Universal Compatibility: Works with ANY Shopify store worldwide
  • Variable Products: Properly imports product variations with attributes (sizes, colors, etc.)
  • Complete Data Import: Imports titles, descriptions, prices, SKUs, and compare-at prices
  • Image Management: Automatically downloads product images and sets up image galleries
  • Smart Categorization: Uses Shopify vendor as brand, product_type as category
  • Flexible Tags: Imports Shopify tags or set your own default tags
  • Simple & Fast: Clean interface, no complicated settings
  • Update Support: Safely updates existing products without duplicating
  • Reliable: No timeouts, proper error handling
  • Professional: Clean code following WordPress and WooCommerce standards

Perfect For

  • HVAC businesses migrating from Shopify
  • E-commerce stores with technical product specifications
  • Businesses with PDF documentation requirements
  • Stores needing automatic product categorization
  • Anyone migrating from Shopify to WooCommerce

How It Works

  1. Export your products from Shopify as JSON
  2. Upload the JSON file to your server
  3. Enter the JSON URL in the plugin admin
  4. Click “Run Import Now”
  5. Products are automatically imported with all specifications and media

Technical Specifications

  • Extracts HTML tables from product descriptions
  • Downloads and hosts PDF files locally
  • Creates product variations automatically
  • Handles image galleries and featured images
  • Manages product attributes and pricing
  • Supports sale prices and regular pricing

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Sufficient server memory for large imports

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support page or contact us at support@cvinfotech.com.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All data processing happens locally on your WordPress installation.

Credits

Developed by CVInfotech – Your trusted WordPress development partner.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopify-import directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Shopify Import’ in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Enter your Shopify JSON URL and click ‘Run Import Now’
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated as it imports products into WooCommerce.

What format should my Shopify data be in?

The plugin expects a JSON file in Shopify’s standard export format. You can export this from your Shopify admin.

Can I update existing products?

Yes, the plugin will update existing products if they match by SKU or title, preserving your existing data while updating with new information.

What happens to product images?

All product images are automatically downloaded and added to your WordPress media library, with the first image set as the featured image.

Can I customize the brand and category assignments?

Yes! Go to Settings > Shopify Import and configure your default brand, category, and tags. Leave fields empty to use Shopify data instead.

Does it handle product variations?

Yes, the plugin fully supports both simple and variable products, including all product variations and attributes.

  • Fixed: Variable products now import correctly with proper attributes and variations

  • Removed: Specifications tab feature (unnecessary complexity)
  • Improved: Simplified settings page – only brand, category, tag options
  • Improved: Better variable product attribute handling
  • Improved: Cleaner import process with better feedback
  • Improved: More reliable – no timeouts on large imports
  • Changed: Focus on core Shopify to WooCommerce migration
  • Updated: All descriptions to reflect actual plugin functionality

2.7.0

  • Major Update: Complete Settings Page
  • New: Works with ANY Shopify store (universal compatibility)
  • New: Configure default brand, category, and tag assignments

2.6.1

  • Fixed: WordPress.org compliance – unique function names
  • Updated: All functions use cvinfotech_swi_ prefix

2.6

  • Initial release
